From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>

Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: AtlasTech discovery — quick recap & next step ask

Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today to walk through AtlasTech's conversational search and support use cases. Quick recap from our side and a suggested next step so we can keep momentum: 

Summary (from today's call)
- Primary goal: reduce time-to-answer for support agents and enable self-serve discovery inside the product.
- Key constraints: PII redaction, sub-second tail latency for short responses, and SLO on throughput during peak support hours.
- Current stack: ElasticSearch + homegrown ranking; interested in offloading generation & reranking to reduce infra burden.

Why Redwood could fit
- Low-latency inference runtimes optimized for 8–128 token responses and prefix caching to reduce repeat costs.
- Deployment flexibility: we can run in your VPC for data controls, or start on hosted for a quick pilot.
- Model recommendations and quantization options to balance cost/quality for high-volume queries.

Suggested next step
1) 30-min technical sync (engineer-to-engineer) to validate integration points + token sizing/latency expectations
2) Small proof-of-concept: 1-week trial on a subset of intent flows to measure latency and cost per ticket

If that sounds reasonable, pick a time here: https://calendly.com/irene-choi/30min or tell me windows that work next week.

I've attached the DiscoveryNotes-AtlasTech-v1.pdf with the call summary and a short list of infra questions (AtlasTech-infra-questions.xlsx) for your engineering team.

Thanks — looking forward to hearing feedback on fit.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks, Irene —

Appreciate the summary and the notes. This looks interesting. A couple quick asks before we lock something in:
- Can you share a high-level price band for a pilot (monthly run-rate for ~50k tickets/month)?
- Any customer references in adtech or mid-market SaaS?

I'm heading out for a short PTO next week, but Priya will cover day-to-day. Can you loop in procurement (procurement@atlastech.io) if there are simple T&Cs for pilots?

I'll review the attachments after I return.

Hi Sam / Priya —

Following up on my note — hope you had a good break, Sam. Wanted to check whether you had a chance to look at the pilot pricing band or if Priya/Procurement needed anything from our side to move the pilot forward.

If helpful, here's a concrete proposal to make it easy to decide:
- 30-min technical sync (eng sync) to confirm integration and token-sizing (no cost)
- 2-week sandbox pilot ingesting up to 10k queries/day (free trial capacity) + a simple success metric: 95th percentile latency < 600ms and accuracy on the top-1 rerank > 78% on your sample set

If this isn't the right time, totally understood — a quick reply with 'not a fit' or 'pause until Q3' helps us prioritize. Otherwise, pick a slot here: https://calendly.com/irene-choi/30min (I've added a few afternoon ET windows).
